conf.description: Zscaler ZIA DNS log (syslog-cef): structural CEF header/extension decode only; field-level ECS mapping is a gap because extension keys are admin-editable, not a fixed schema

conf.comment: Zscaler ZIA DNS log, syslog-cef, direct route (no guard hop). This dataset supplies no field rows (fields: []) for this format: the on-wire key/column names are operator-defined by the NSS Feed Output Format template, not a fixed vendor schema, and the work order's own mnemonic hints are inconsistent (e.g. web CEF notes name 'eurl' in one place, 'ehost'+'b64url' in another for what may be the same token). Per the brief, no field-level ECS rename is attempted here - only structural decode plus event.dataset. Field-level mapping is a gap - see README.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose and the operator-defined-keys gap
Split the 7 pipe-delimited CEF header slots from the extension blob
Explode the CEF extension's key=value pairs into top-level fields (unverified against a live sample - see README)
Tag event.dataset; _raw kept since field-level mapping is not attempted for this format
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
